summary: Iter 41 — Enterprise module (e) PIANIFICAZIONE TURNI tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (/api/shifts CRUD, hours calc 06:00-14:30=8.5h, night wrap 22:00-06:00=8h, PUT recompute 9.25h, store scoping, 422 validation, 401 anon, 403 non-PRO, 404 delete-inexistent). Frontend UI (430x900): admin PRO login -> home-section-enterprise -> enterprise-hub -> shifts-need-store shown with no store -> created store in Negozi tab -> enterprise-tab-turni -> shifts-manager with week navigator; added 2 shifts (Mon 06:00-14:30 = 8.5h, Wed 22:00-06:00 = 8h), per-shift hours correct, shifts-hours summary TEST_Luca 16.5h correct, week total in header; shift-week-next shows 0 shifts (date-bound, correct) and prev restores 2; delete removed card and summary updated to 8h. Non-PRO (fornaio@) sees PaywallGate instead of the hub. Regression: Negozi and Ordini tabs render without errors. Test data cleaned up (0 TEST_ shifts/stores left).

design_issues.screen: Enterprise > Turni (bottom of list) and Enterprise paywall
issues: Floating 'Radio' and 'Parla' FABs overlap the 'ORE PER PERSONA' summary rows and the paywall CTA text/buttons on 430px viewport; content is partially hidden behind them (pb-40 not enough / FABs not offset).
Feature list still advertises only Multi-Negozio/Ordini; the new 'Turni' module is not mentioned in the paywall preview.

action_items: Optional: raise bottom padding / offset floating Radio-Parla FABs so the hours summary and paywall CTA are not covered on small viewports.
Optional: add 'Turni' to the Enterprise paywall feature preview list.

Optional hardening: ShiftsManager iso() uses Date.toISOString() on a local-midnight date; in timezones with positive UTC offset the week grid could shift by one day. Use local YYYY-MM-DD formatting instead.
critical_code_review_comments: ShiftsManager.jsx: iso() = d.toISOString().slice(0,10) on a local-midnight Date is timezone-fragile (UTC+X shifts day back by 1). Build the ISO string from getFullYear/getMonth/getDate.
shiftsApi.list swallows all errors with .catch(() => []) — a 403/500 renders as an empty calendar with no error state; surface an error/toast.
server.py is ~2486 lines; consider splitting routers (shifts/stores/orders) into modules per the <700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: Temporary store TEST_UI_Negozio + TEST_ shifts created via UI/API; all deleted at the end (verified 0 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Turni module fully green (backend + UI). Reusable pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_iter41_shifts.py. Enterprise reachable only via home card home-section-enterprise (no bottom-nav tab); login must be explicit via login-btn -> auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit. Day/form testids embed local ISO date (monday of current week).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Only cosmetic overlap of floating action buttons over bottom content and timezone-fragile ISO date helper (not reproducible in UTC container).
